en: The evening or night of today; or during the night of today.
ex: We are going to the movies tonight.
我們今晚要去看電影。

en: Also; or more than is needed or wanted; or very.
ex: It is too hot to play outside today.
今天太熱了，不能到外面玩。

en: A piece of equipment that you hold in your hand to do a particular job.
ex: A hammer is a useful tool for building.
鐵鎚是蓋東西時有用的工具。

en: One of the hard white parts in your mouth that you use for biting and chewing.
ex: You should brush your teeth twice a day.
你一天應該刷兩次牙。

en: The highest part of something; or the best or highest position; or a toy that spins.
ex: We reached the top of the mountain at noon.
我們中午抵達山頂。

en: A subject that you talk or write about.
ex: What is the topic of your speech?
你演講的主題是什麼？

en: Including everything; or the sum of all the parts; or to add up numbers.
ex: The total cost of the trip is five hundred dollars.
這趟旅行的總費用是五百美元。

en: To put your hand on something; or to have a gentle effect on someone's feelings; or the sense of feeling.
ex: Please do not touch the paintings in the museum.
請不要碰博物館裡的畫作。

en: A piece of thick cloth used for drying your body or hands; or to dry something with a towel.
ex: She dried her hands with a clean towel.
她用乾淨的毛巾擦乾手。

en: A place where people live and work, larger than a village but smaller than a city.
ex: She lives in a small town near the sea.
她住在海邊的一個小鎮。

en: An object for children to play with; or a small copy of something; or to play with an idea.
ex: The child is playing with a toy car.
那個孩子正在玩玩具車。

en: The vehicles that are traveling on a road at a particular time; or the movement of ships and planes; or illegal trade.
ex: There was heavy traffic on the highway this morning.
今天早上高速公路車流量很大。

en: A vehicle on rails that carries passengers or goods; or to teach someone a skill; or to practice for a sport.
ex: We took the train to Taipei on Saturday.
我們星期六搭火車去台北。

en: To behave toward someone in a certain way; or to give medical care to someone; or a special gift or event.
ex: The doctor treated her cold with medicine.
醫生用藥治療她的感冒。

en: A tall plant with a thick wooden trunk, branches and leaves.
ex: The children climbed up the big tree.
孩子們爬上那棵大樹。

en: A journey to a place and back; or to catch your foot on something and fall.
ex: We took a trip to the mountains last summer.
去年夏天我們去山上旅行。

en: Problems or difficulties; or to bother or worry someone.
ex: I had trouble finding the house in the dark.
我在黑暗中找房子遇到困難。

en: A large road vehicle for carrying goods.
ex: A big truck delivered the furniture to our house.
一輛大卡車把家具送到我們家。

en: To make an effort to do something; or to test something to see if you like it; or an attempt.
ex: Please try this cake and tell me what you think.
請嚐嚐這個蛋糕，告訴我你覺得怎麼樣。

en: To move your body so you face another direction; or to move around a central point; or your chance to do something.
ex: Turn right at the next corner.
在下個轉角右轉。

en: Two times; or double the amount.
ex: I go to the gym twice a week.
我一週去兩次健身房。

en: A group of people or things with similar qualities; or to write words using a keyboard.
ex: What type of music do you like best?
你最喜歡哪種音樂？

en: The brother of your father or mother, or the husband of your aunt.
ex: My uncle lives in Canada and visits us every year.
我叔叔住在加拿大，每年都來看我們。

en: Lower than something; or covered by something; or less than a particular amount or age.
ex: The cat is sleeping under the table.
貓在桌子下面睡覺。

en: To know what someone or something means; or to realize something.
ex: I don't understand this math problem.
我不懂這道數學題。

en: The special clothes that all people in a school, army or company wear; or the same in all parts.
ex: All the students at our school wear uniforms.
我們學校的所有學生都穿制服。

en: Up to the time that something happens; or before a certain time.
ex: Please wait here until I come back.
請在這裡等到我回來。

en: Toward a higher place; or out of bed; or increasing.
ex: She gets up at six o'clock every morning.
她每天早上六點起床。

en: To do something with a tool or a method; or to take or consume something; or the act of using something.
ex: May I use your phone for a moment?
我可以借用你的電話一下嗎？

en: Helpful or valuable for a purpose.
ex: This dictionary is very useful for learning English.
這本字典對學英語非常有用。

en: In most cases or on most occasions; as a habit.
ex: I usually have toast and milk for breakfast.
我早餐通常吃吐司和牛奶。

en: A plant, or part of a plant, that you eat as food, such as carrots, cabbage and potatoes.
ex: You should eat more vegetables every day.
你每天應該多吃蔬菜。

en: To a high degree; extremely; or exactly the right one.
ex: Thank you very much for your help.
非常謝謝你的幫忙。

en: A recording of moving pictures and sound; or relating to recording or playing pictures.
ex: We watched a video about wild animals in class.
我們在課堂上看了一部關於野生動物的影片。

en: A musical instrument with four strings that you play with a bow, held under your chin.
ex: She plays the violin in the school orchestra.
她在學校管弦樂團裡拉小提琴。

en: A polite word for a woman; or a woman of good manners; or a title for a woman of high rank.
ex: The old lady crossed the street slowly.
那位老太太慢慢地過了馬路。

en: Causing pain in your body or mind; or difficult and unpleasant.
ex: The cut on my finger is painful.
我手指上的傷口很痛。

en: A piece of information that you send to someone, written or spoken; or the main idea of something.
ex: I left a message on his phone.
我在他的電話上留了言。

en: Something you are trying to reach or hit; or a goal you try to achieve; or to aim at something.
ex: The arrow hit the target in the center.
箭射中了靶心。

en: A tool with a long handle used for cleaning floors; or to clean a floor with this tool.
ex: He used a mop to clean the kitchen floor.
他用拖把清潔廚房地板。
